title: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
sourceTitle: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
scientists: Zhuosen Wang (University of Maryland), Miguel Roman (Leidos), Ranjay Shrestha (SSAI), Srija Chakraborty (USRA), Virginia Kalb (NASA)
datasetCredits: Black Marble (Black Marble: Next Generation) [Suomi NPP: VIIRS], "NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Roman, NASA GSFC."
description: flat map of night lights; annual averages 2012-2023, then change (PURPLE = increase, ORANGE = decrease), then zoomed views of India, Ukraine, Western Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Wide aspect ratio version made for the NASA Earth Information Center.
altText: Global flat map of nocturnal city lights emissions, showing human settlement networks and night illumination.
notes: In the "change" part, PURPLE = increase, ORANGE = decrease; first part = annual averages 2012-2023; later part has zoomed views of India, Ukraine, Western Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean.

title: Perpetual Ocean 2: Western Boundary Currents
visualizers: Greg Shirah (NASA/GSFC), Horace Mitchell (NASA/GSFC); Technical support: Laurence Schuler, Ian Jones (ADNET Systems, Inc.); Producer: Kathleen Gaeta (Advocates in Manpower Management, Inc.)
scientists: Atousa Saberi (NASA/GSFC), Josh Willis (JPL); Producer: Kathleen Gaeta (Advocates in Manpower Management, Inc.)
datasetCredits: BMNG Blue Marble imagery (courtesy of Reto Stockli, NASA/GSFC), ECCO2 (NASA/JPL), ETOPO-30 (NOAA)
description: rotating globe of ocean currents, zoom to the Kuroshio Current, the Agulhas Current and the Gulf Stream, using the ECCO-2 ocean model.
altText: Global rotating ocean current simulation showing swirling white and cyan fluid flow streamlines of the Gulf Stream and western boundary currents.
notes: White and cyan swirling current streamlines against oceanic depths; highlighting high-energy western boundary currents.

title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
sourceTitle: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
visualizers: Greg Shirah (NASA/GSFC); Animators: Greg Shirah, Horace Mitchell (NASA/GSFC), Eric Sokolowsky (Global Science and Technology, Inc.); Producer: Michael Starobin (HTSI)
description: sea surface currents coloured by sea surface temperature, from ECCO2 model output (surface flows only).
altText: Scientific color bar legend for sea surface temperature from -3°C to 22°C alongside ocean currents.
notes: Temperature scale: -3°C (deep blue) through 12°C (sky blue) to 22°C+ (white). Surface currents show fluid flow circulation across global ocean basins.

title: NASA Blue Marble: Eastern & Western Hemispheres
scientists: NASA GSFC MODIS Land Science Team
datasetCredits: Terra MODIS land surface, ocean chlorophyll, clouds, sea ice
description: True-color satellite composite combining MODIS land surface, ocean chlorophyl, clouds, and polar ice sheets into a photorealistic planetary view.
altText: Satellite photograph of planet Earth showing blue oceans, white swirling storm cloud formations, green terrestrial vegetation, and brown arid land masses.

title: Climate Warming Stripes (1880–2025)
sourceTitle: Warming Stripes visualization based on NASA GISTEMP v4
credit: NASA GISS / University of Reading (Prof. Ed Hawkins)
datasetCredits: NASA GISTEMP v4 (Global Land-Ocean Temperature Index)
description: A visual chronometer of Earth's climate history: each vertical stripe represents one consecutive year's temperature anomaly from cool blues to extreme deep red.
altText: Visual stripe diagram starting with deep blues in 1880, pale cyans in mid-20th century, transitioning rapidly to bright orange and dark crimson bars in recent decades.

title: Current 3D Earth Camera View (Live Frame)
datasetCredits: Three.js WebGL Real-time Buffer + NASA Blue Marble Day & Night Textures
description: Direct frame grab from the active interactive 3D WebGL globe, reflecting the user's selected camera angle, rotation, and current temperature glow.
altText: Current 3D rendered viewpoint of planet Earth with real-time solar illumination and data-driven atmospheric glow.
